name: hv15_dbk_bank-geo1-COMMIT
purpose: DMA STORE back landing bank, the hb_dbk parent standard bank (one master x32): geometry re-kit, both data buses on the W face at the SRAM pin edge, 140.4x87.48; RTL unchanged from pf1 (native PASS).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_dma_back_landing_bank u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp_banks.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hv15_dbk_bank/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hv15_dbk_bank/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hv15_dbk_bank --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_dma_back_landing_bank --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: All bank inputs registered at the pins (no input reaches the SRAM macro); write enable from the raw response valid and slot from the controller one edge ahead keep the write edge; read sampled one edge later with the separate capture stage removed keeps the wd edge. 0 cycles.

reroute_reason.slot_change_request: geometry (owner 20:45 visual inspection + coordinator 10-15): pf1 view had wd[288:0] on the E face while the SRAM's rd_out/wd_in pins are on its W edge (256 read bits crossed ~120 um around the macro) and 36% fill. geo1: rr_data AND wd both on the W face next to the macro pin edge (all macro pins are on its LEF W edge, so mirroring cannot serve both buses), control on N; outline 140.4 x 87.48 = the 20 um macro-channel rule minimum for this 94.8x41.06 SRAM (140.4 x 64 / 55% fill is not reachable under the rule: needs abut_plan or a 2-SRAM bank leaf). One master for all 32 banks. Told H-DIE.
reroute_reason.why_route: geometry: pins far from consumers, 36% fill
